meta.title: Pressure Players: Who Delivers When It Matters
meta.units: Pressure value and step-up are win-probability points per 100 balls; match_series values are win-probability points added per pressure innings (leverage-adjusted)

bat.name: Phil Salt
strengths: Boundary hitting under pressure: 26.3% of balls reach the boundary (better than 89% of eligible players)
Chasing under pressure: 18.2 win-probability points per 100 balls (top 14% of eligible players)
Consistency: positive in 20 of 28 pressure innings
Highly stable pick: in the top 10 in 98% of bootstrap resamples
weaknesses: Dot-ball control under pressure: 42.7% dot balls (weaker than 84% of eligible players)
